title: The Fox Who Called the Fruit Sour 🦊 | A Japanese Fable, Sung
tiktok_title: He couldn't reach the fruit. So he called it sour.
caption:
He jumped all day and couldn't reach them… so he said they were sour anyway. 🦊 Ever told yourself you didn't want it? An old fable about sour grapes, sung in woodblock prints.

#talesinink #moralstories #fable #ukiyoe #shorts #aesop #mindset #storytime
moral: It's easy to scorn what you cannot reach.
